name: Pipeliners - SEO Results Scorecard 2026-10-12
body:
> Tracker · Pipeliners · 2026-10-12

# Summary
"Pipeliners SEO Results Scorecard" (`change-tracker.html`, built from `data.json` with a template): for every page changed since Sep 1, it compares Google numbers in a locked 28-day "before" window with the period after go-live. Updated every Monday; last updated Oct 12, 2026.

# Key points
- Source: GSC Pages report, Domain property, all countries, read in the GSC web UI. The Search Atlas API was dropped on Sep 21 because it leaves out anonymized searches.
- Rules: compare impressions per day; Up or Down only when a page moves at least 15 points more than the whole site; under 60 before-window impressions is too small to call; clicks are what count; a change needs 14+ days of data.
- Groups tracked: Sep 1 work (window closed Sep 15 because pages changed again), Sep 15 to 16 Step 7 and Step 8 city pages, quick wins and the Buckeye pipe-break section, Sep 18 to 23 blog merges and keyword alignment, Goodyear and others. Full reads due Oct 19 and Oct 26.
- Notes flag later changes inside windows (Sep 29 AI-answer batch, Oct 2 links, Oct 8 schema fix and merges, Avondale rebuild Oct 10).
- GBP clicks are excluded (they land on the homepage).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `change-tracker.html`, `template.html`, `data.json`, `pull-2026-10-06.json`, `build.py`; dated `.bak` copies of data and template (Sep 22 to Oct 8) are backups only.
